title: Shift compatibility passes to the adjunction mate of a square
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D,\mathcal C',\mathcal D'$ be categories with coherent integer shifts $[n]$. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be left adjoint to $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$, and $L':\mathcal C'\to\mathcal D'$ left adjoint to $R':\mathcal D'\to\mathcal C'$, with units $\eta,\eta'$ and counits $\varepsilon,\varepsilon'$ satisfying the triangle identities [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Let $r:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C'$ and $t:\mathcal D\to\mathcal D'$ be functors. Give all six functors specified coherent shift isomorphisms $\sigma_{H,X}:H(X[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}(HX)[n]$, natural in $X$, with the composite convention of [lem-weil-pbc-commshift-nattrans-comp-whisker]. For each $n$, write $a,b,a',b'$ for those of $L,R,L',R'$, and $c_P=\sigma_{r,P}$, $e_E=\sigma_{t,E}$. Assume the two unit equations
$$\eta_P[n]=b_{LP}\circ R(a_P)\circ\eta_{P[n]},\qquad \eta'_A[n]=b'_{L'A}\circ R'(a'_A)\circ\eta'_{A[n]}$$
for all $P\in\mathcal C,A\in\mathcal C'$ [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique]. Let $\beta:rR\to R't$ be any natural transformation satisfying, for every $E\in\mathcal D$ and integer $n$,
$$b'_{tE}\circ R'(e_E)\circ\beta_{E[n]}=\beta_E[n]\circ c_{RE}\circ r(b_E).$$
Define $h_P=\beta_{LP}\circ r(\eta_P):rP\to R'tLP$ and its adjunct $\theta_P=\varepsilon'_{tLP}\circ L'(h_P):L'rP\to tLP$. For $B=tLP$ put $d_P=e_{LP}\circ t(a_P):tL(P[n])\to B[n]$. Then
$$b'_B\circ R'(d_P)\circ h_{P[n]}=h_P[n]\circ c_P,$$
and the adjuncts under $L'\dashv R'$ of the two maps from $L'r(P[n])$ to $B[n]$ given by $d_P\circ\theta_{P[n]}$ and $\theta_P[n]\circ a'_{rP}\circ L'(c_P)$ are respectively
$$R'(d_P)\circ h_{P[n]},\qquad (b'_B)^{-1}\circ h_P[n]\circ c_P.$$
In particular the mate satisfies the shift equation
$$d_P\circ\theta_{P[n]}=\theta_P[n]\circ a'_{rP}\circ L'(c_P).$$
No invertibility of $\beta$ or $\theta$, adjoints of $r,t$, triangulated structure, or strict commutation of $r,t$ with shift is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0A8D, lemma-adjoint-is-exact, construction of the adjoint shift map. Four-category mate-square refinement and the explicit adjunct equations are agent-written; not a verbatim Stacks lemma.

proof.text:
Fix an integer $n$ and $P\in\mathcal C$; every comparison below is for this $n$. Use the composite comparison convention of [lem-weil-pbc-commshift-nattrans-comp-whisker]. Expand $h_{P[n]}$ and $d_P$. Naturality of $\beta$ at $a_P:L(P[n])\to (LP)[n]$, the assumed shift equation for $\beta$ at $LP$, the unprimed unit equation, and naturality of $c$ at $\eta_P$ give, in this order,
$$\begin{aligned}
b'_B R'(d_P)h_{P[n]}
&=b'_{tLP}R'(e_{LP})R'(t(a_P))\beta_{L(P[n])}r(\eta_{P[n]})\\
&=b'_{tLP}R'(e_{LP})\beta_{(LP)[n]}r(R(a_P))r(\eta_{P[n]})\\
&=\beta_{LP}[n]c_{RLP}r(b_{LP})r(R(a_P))r(\eta_{P[n]})\\
&=\beta_{LP}[n]c_{RLP}r(\eta_P[n])\\
&=\beta_{LP}[n](r(\eta_P))[n]c_P=h_P[n]c_P.
\end{aligned}$$
Juxtaposition denotes composition, with the rightmost map applied first. Every equality here is substitution of a stated hypothesis or the naturality/functor laws, so no additional comparison lemma is being used.

proof.text: For the primed adjunction write $\Phi_{X,Y}(u)=R'(u)\eta'_X$. The hom-bijection and inverse formulas of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], specialized to $F=L'$ and $G=R'$, give $\Phi^{-1}_{X,Y}(v)=\varepsilon'_Y L'(v)$. Thus $\theta_P=\Phi^{-1}_{rP,B}(h_P)$, so $\Phi_{rP,B}(\theta_P)=h_P$; the same holds with $P[n]$ replacing $P$. The hom-bijection is injective for each fixed pair $X,Y$.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint and the following paragraph, equivalence of the three descriptions of adjunct morphisms

proof.text:
The first map in the statement has source $L'r(P[n])$ and target $B[n]$. Apply the target-naturality equation for the hom-bijection in [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] with $u=\theta_{P[n]}$ and postcomposition $d_P:tL(P[n])\to B[n]$. Step 2 gives
$$\Phi_{r(P[n]),B[n]}(d_P\theta_{P[n]})=R'(d_P)\Phi_{r(P[n]),tL(P[n])}(\theta_{P[n]})=R'(d_P)h_{P[n]}.$$
This is the first requested adjunct formula.

source.place: Tag 0037, definition-adjoint: naturality in the target

proof.text:
Apply clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-shift-compatibility-unique] to $L'\dashv R'$ and its given unit-compatible pair $(a',b')$. It gives
$$\varepsilon'_{B[n]}=\varepsilon'_B[n]a'_{R'B}L'(b'_B).$$
Put $q=(b'_B)^{-1}h_P[n]c_P:r(P[n])\to R'(B[n])$. By the inverse hom-bijection formula of [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection], the displayed counit equation, cancellation of $L'(b'_B)$ with $L'((b'_B)^{-1})$, and naturality of $a'$ at $h_P:rP\to R'B$, respectively,
$$\begin{aligned}
\Phi^{-1}_{r(P[n]),B[n]}(q)
&=\varepsilon'_{B[n]}L'((b'_B)^{-1})L'(h_P[n])L'(c_P)\\
&=\varepsilon'_B[n]a'_{R'B}L'(h_P[n])L'(c_P)\\
&=\varepsilon'_B[n](L'(h_P))[n]a'_{rP}L'(c_P)\\
&=\theta_P[n]a'_{rP}L'(c_P).
\end{aligned}$$
Applying $\Phi$ proves that the adjunct of the second map is exactly $q$, as asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A8D, lemma-adjoint-is-exact, first paragraph of proof (adjoint shift construction); unit-to-counit compatibility is the cited Mathlib leaf, and the displayed four-category calculation is agent-written

proof.text:
Postcompose the equality of Step 1 with $(b'_B)^{-1}$. This gives $R'(d_P)h_{P[n]}=(b'_B)^{-1}h_P[n]c_P$. Steps 3 and 4 therefore give equal images under the same bijection $\Phi_{r(P[n]),B[n]}$. Injectivity from [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection] yields
$$d_P\theta_{P[n]}=\theta_P[n]a'_{rP}L'(c_P).$$
The argument applies separately to every integer $n$. It uses inverse maps only for the specified shift isomorphisms; thus it requires no invertibility of $\beta$ or $\theta$, no adjoints of $r,t$, and no triangulated structure.
